title: AsyncTool: Evaluating the Asynchronous Function Calling Capability under Multi-Task Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2605.27995v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown strong capabilities in using external tools to solve complex tasks. However, existing evaluations often overlook the temporal dimension of tool use, especially the impact of tool response latency, and are usually limited to single-task settings. In real-world applications, multiple tasks often need to be executed concurrently, and overall efficiency depends on whether an agent can use idle time while waiting for tool responses. We refer to this capability as asynchronous tool calling. To evaluate it, we propose AsyncTool, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based agents in interactive multi-task tool-use environments with delayed tool feedback. AsyncTool presents multiple heterogeneous tasks simultaneously and simulates realistic tool response latency during execution. translated_title: AsyncTool：评估多任务场景下的异步函数调用能力
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在使用外部工具解决复杂任务方面已展现出强大的能力。然而，现有的评估往往忽略了工具使用中的时间维度，尤其是工具响应延迟的影响，且通常局限于单任务设置。在现实应用中，多个任务往往需要并发执行，整体效率取决于智能体能否在等待工具响应的空闲时间内加以利用。我们将这种能力称为异步工具调用。为了评估这一能力，我们提出了 AsyncTool，这是一个用于评估基于LLM的智能体在具有延迟工具反馈的交互式多任务工具使用环境中表现的基准。AsyncTool 同时呈现多个异构任务，并在执行过程中模拟真实的工具响应延迟。通过混合数据演化策略，我们构建了一个多样化的异步多任务数据集，涵盖多个场景。
tldr: 提出 AsyncTool 基准，通过模拟工具响应延迟的交互式多任务环境，评估大语言模型智能体在等待工具响应期间利用空闲时间并发处理多个任务的异步工具调用能力。
en_tdlr: We propose AsyncTool, a benchmark that evaluates the asynchronous tool calling capability of LLM-based agents—i.e., their ability to exploit idle time while waiting for delayed tool responses to concurrently handle multiple heterogeneous tasks in interactive multi-task environments.
